cls: Androgen ester (component of mixed testosterone esters)
pharm: Androgen ester (component of mixed testosterone esters)
quick: 250 mg (1 mL of the mixed esters) every 3 weeks
summary: Testosterone phenylpropionate is one of four esters in mixed testosterone injection (propionate 30 mg, phenylpropionate 60 mg, isocaproate 60 mg, decanoate 100 mg per mL). The mix gives rapid and sustained levels.

dosage.d: 250 mg (1 mL of the mixed esters) every 3 weeks
dosage.n: Adjust to trough testosterone and haematocrit

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Androgen receptor agonist after ester hydrolysis to testosterone.

relative: Severe heart, liver or kidney failure

counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
